rationale_en: LRMs around a slash in a date.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: RLM between a letter and its haraka: removed, leaving the haraka on the letter.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: RLM between alef and combining hamza blocks NFC composition; once the RLM is removed, NFC composes U+0623.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic comma U+060C: kept by bayanat-norm-v1, replaced by a space and collapsed by asr-eval-v1.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic semicolon U+061B.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic question mark U+061F.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Guillemets.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic full stop U+06D4 (Urdu).
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: ASCII exclamation mark after Arabic text.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic five pointed star U+066D is punctuation.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Ornate parentheses in reading order.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic comma without spaces: asr-eval-v1 replaces it with a space, so the words stay apart.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic date separator U+060D alone.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic triple dot punctuation mark U+061E.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Curly double quotation marks.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Hyphen between two words.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Horizontal ellipsis: NFKC turns it into three full stops; asr-eval-v1 removes it.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: No-break space U+00A0: kept by bayanat-norm-v1, becomes a space in asr-eval-v1 and NFKC.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Narrow no-break space U+202F.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Thin space U+2009.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Em space U+2003.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Ideographic space U+3000.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Three ASCII spaces: collapsed by asr-eval-v1 only.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Leading and trailing spaces: trimmed by asr-eval-v1 only.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Tab and line feed are whitespace.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Next line U+0085 is a whitespace control and is not rejected.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Line separator U+2028.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A no-break space alone.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Medium mathematical space U+205F.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Latin letter case is kept by every policy.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabizi: Latin letters with digits standing for Arabic sounds are unchanged.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Emoji after Arabic text is kept.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Latin ligature fi: NFKC folds it, the folding policies keep it.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Fullwidth Latin letters: NFKC folds them, the folding policies keep them.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Hebrew and Arabic words side by side.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Latin e + combining acute: NFC composes U+00E9 in every policy except identity.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A URL with an Arabic path: asr-eval-v1 replaces the punctuation with spaces.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A hashtag: number sign is punctuation.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic and Persian spellings of the same word stay different.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Veh U+06A4 (used for /v/ in many dialects) must survive every policy.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Qaf with three dots above U+06A8 (Maghrebi /g/) must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Keheh with three dots above U+0763 (Moroccan /g/) must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Ng U+06AD must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Peh U+067E must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Tcheh U+0686 (Gulf and Iraqi /ch/) must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Gaf U+06AF (Gulf and Iraqi /g/) must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Veh with harakat: the harakat are removed, the letter stays.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Veh with tatweels.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Veh initial presentation form in a word: mapped to U+06A4, which then survives.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Jeh U+0698 must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Maghrebi feh U+06A2 and qaf U+06A7 must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Ve U+06CB must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Lam with small v U+06B5 must survive.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Gaf with damma and shadda.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic-Indic zero U+0660 and Extended Arabic-Indic zero U+06F0 look alike; both become ASCII 0.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic-Indic four and Extended Arabic-Indic four (different glyphs, same value).
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic-Indic five and Extended Arabic-Indic five.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic yeh and Farsi yeh look alike in final form; the policies keep them apart.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic kaf and keheh: kept apart.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Heh and heh goal U+06C1: kept apart.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Heh and heh doachashmee U+06BE: kept apart.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Alef and Arabic-Indic one look alike; only the digit is mapped.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic-Indic five and heh look alike in some fonts; only the digit is mapped.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic comma and ASCII comma: both are punctuation for asr-eval-v1.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Arabic percent sign and ASCII percent sign are both punctuation (Po).
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Alef maqsura and Farsi yeh look alike; only alef maqsura is mapped (to yeh).
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A combining mark at the start of the text (no base letter): kept by NFC and raw-safe-v1, removed with the other harakat by bayanat-norm-v1.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A combining hamza alone: it is not a haraka and has no alef to fold, so every policy keeps it.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Doubled fatha: NFC keeps both; bayanat-norm-v1 removes both.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Tripled shadda.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A lone high surrogate (possible in Python strings and JSON): removed by the cleaning policies; NFC/NFKC in Python pass it through.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A lone low surrogate at the end.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Noncharacter U+FDD0 (inside the Arabic Presentation Forms-A block) is removed by the cleaning policies.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Noncharacter U+FFFE is removed.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: C0 control U+0001 is removed.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: C1 control U+0090 is removed.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: The replacement character U+FFFD is a valid character and is kept.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: Truncated UTF-8: the last byte starts a two-byte sequence that never ends. Every policy rejects the input.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: A UTF-8 continuation byte with no lead byte.
author: Bayanat Labs

rationale_en: UTF-8 encoding of the surrogate U+D800, which is not valid UTF-8.
author: Bayanat Labs
